h1: Custom Folding Bar Wine Gift Sets
metaTitle: Custom Folding Bar Wine Gift Sets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom folding bar wine gift sets for bulk corporate gifting. Perfect for promotions and client appreciation.
introHtml: Custom folding bar wine gift sets combine portability with premium presentation, making them ideal for corporate gifts that travel well. The folding design collapses flat for easy storage and shipping, yet opens into a sturdy serving station for wine tastings, picnics, or tailgates. Choose from leatherette or wood finishes, and add your logo via foil stamping or screen printing for a polished brand impression. These sets typically include two wine glasses and a corkscrew, offering a complete gift experience in one compact package.
heroAltText: Custom folding bar wine gift set with two wine glasses and corkscrew, logo imprinted on leatherette case
